files.README.md:
# payments-api workspace

payments-api captures charges through the StraitsPay gateway. Application logs live under logs/: the current segment plus the previous rotated segment with a .1 suffix.

E_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT marks a capture request that timed out at the gateway.
files.docs/vendor-contacts.md:
# Gateway vendor contacts

- StraitsPay support: desk@straitspay-gw.com, +65 6312 4488 (24/5 coverage).
- AuroraPay support: helpdesk@aurorapay.io, +351 21 955 0440 (business hours CET).
- Escalate P1 capture outages to the payments-platform on-call after 15 minutes without recovery.
